extraContent.description: The translation introduces the specific categories 'Les petits' (the little ones) and 'les grands' (the great ones) and explicitly states they are 'néant' (nothing), whereas OSMAIN v9 uses 'menneskers barn' (children of men) and 'fornemme menns sønner' (sons of noble men) with the descriptors 'pust' (breath) and 'løgn' (lie). The translation expands the text by interpreting 'children of men' as 'little ones' and equating them to 'nothing', which is an interpretative addition not present in the literal OSMAIN wording.
